title: PlayAh! Revenue & TikTok Shop Scaling
summary: Scaled TikTokShop revenue from tens of millions to over 1B VND/mo, boosted website revenue 10x in 2 months, and grew Facebook revenue by 300% via AI sales funnels.
description:
Faced with fragmented channel performance, the priority was building a unified, scalable growth engine across TikTokShop, Website, and Facebook while maintaining ROAS above industry benchmarks.

Scaled TikTokShop revenue to 1B+ VND monthly by building KOC booking channels and AI sales personas. Increased website revenue by 1,000% through multi-channel ad strategies across Google (PMax & Search), TikTok Spark Ads, and Meta-to-Web funnels. Deployed automated AI conversion flows on Facebook Fanpage to raise conversion rates and drive 300% revenue growth. Led cross-functional alignment with Creative (website rebuild), Brand (asset production), and Affiliate teams (content briefs), while coaching internal execution teams on Meta and TikTok Ads.

Achieved 10x website revenue growth within 2 months through integrated paid media funnels while maintaining high ROAS, establishing category leadership on TikTokShop, and elevating team marketing capabilities.
